message: Perfect straight-column track alignment, full playlist shuffle & download functionality, resilient shared playlist import for huge cut-off links, and cleaned library screen.
releaseNotes: Fixed zig-zag alignment on track rows: titles, artist names, language badges, tabular durations, and action buttons now align in dead-straight vertical columns
Added functional SHUFFLE and DOWNLOAD ALL buttons inside custom and liked playlists
Resilient fallback parser for importing shared playlists from chat apps (e.g. WhatsApp) that cut off huge links or introduce broken URL encoding
Quick Update access available from both Library tab and Profile modal
